clauses.evidence: [turns pass]: ability [1] triggers once (your end step only, not the opponent's), 0 Treasures with no deaths. Tree = parse template B2a-gadrak-treasures. Count NOT_EXERCISED in the trace; pack gadrak_end_step_treasures.json: your nontoken + opponent's nontoken + your token creature die -> 2 Treasures at your end step; a death on the opponent's turn and the opponent's end step -> none; your next end step with no deaths this turn -> none (total 2) - PASS

clauses.clause: (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.") [reminder]
clauses.evidence: TokenSpec: colorless Artifact named Treasure, keywords (TREASURE,) = the engine's Treasure artifact-type marker (ability_tree.py:807), ActivatedAbility {T} + sacrifice self -> ADD_MANA 1 ANY to YOU, matching CR 111.10a. Engine-minted tokens have no pack address, so it cannot be activated from a pack; the same ability on the Treasure golden is exercised by tools/scenarios/treasure_token_activation.json
clauses.issue: note: the Treasure type is carried as Keyword.TREASURE, not as subtypes=('Treasure',) (type_line 'Artifact'); nothing in the 19 sets reads either. Gadrak itself also carries Keyword.TREASURE (from the MTGJSON keyword list, compiler.py:118); no engine code reads that keyword, so it is inert, but Gadrak is not a Treasure and a future Treasure-counting filter keyed on it would miscount
